structural_guards.requirement: One canonical derive-next semantic contract; host adapters do not maintain independent routing tables.
One exact Git identity resolver distinguishes parsed identity from verified object/bytes.
Caller assertions such as observed=true are not authoritative unless the calling contract supplies verified evidence.
Relational closure is validated before fallback routing.
Current checkpoint publication is expected-old/freshness fenced and positively read back.
Review state handling is exhaustive; default else never means RED, GREEN, Execution or Close.
Result/Review/accepted Plan history is immutable and append-only.
Semantic independence records material authorship/repair facts, not runtime/model/session IDs.
One current writer per artifact kind; historical readers never become alternate historical writers.
Artifact-version dispatch is explicit PWV3 lineage + artifact kind + declared producing contract; no inference from file age, release number, branch or runtime package.
Compatibility policy is code/test policy, not a second per-workstream compatibility database.
Context packs/optimization include mandatory authority/dependency/acceptance closure or fall back safely; context pack is never authority.
Runtime/package update machinery never silently migrates semantic state.
Native Pi tool, CLI and any optional adapter share one semantic core.
Generic Worker recursive delegation is absent from v1 authority; runtime enforcement plus acceptance fencing prevents out-of-envelope effects.
Worker publication is accepted only after exact remote readback.
ChatGPT Project Instructions, project AGENTS or other prose cannot redefine trusted package origin, workflow legality, credentials or canonical state.
Global Pi package remains inert outside a PWV3 repository/lineage.
Duplicate/shadow helper identity is rejected or deterministically resolved to the exact qualified package; nearest-copy-wins is not authority.
Regression-oracle quality is itself guarded by mutation/meta-tests for high-risk structured predicates.

d12_seams.requirement: Universal OP frontier: first attempt before dispatch; crash before/after ack; same-binding resolved non-advancing terminal produces exactly one successor; changed binding cannot reuse old attempt.
Non-Global gate: no synthetic owner choice; resolved RUN OP AGAIN rechecks drift before its cut; crash before/after cut; old GREEN/choice cannot return; duplicate TERMINAL consumption is idempotent.

Global seam: no routine CLEAR owner gate; explicit same-binding repeat just before intent, at intent-UNKNOWN and after cut; terminal acceptance superseded; current non-advancing Global blocks old CLEAR.

QF: old applicable acceptance is not fresh; terminal successor supersedes success before execution; current RED/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN prevents fallback; automatic read-only independence versus executor self-review; exact authorized waiver honesty.

Card seam: Result before Review never advances; qualification repair attributes/conservatively widens affected Cards, reopens in total order, new Result + invalidated checks, upstream semantic change not absorbed locally.

Invocation seam: provenance publish/readback before first material write/effect, crash/UNKNOWN cut, rebind same package on another host; no mode field; goal-capable actual delegated implementation use, not idle capability.
Capability: one safe qualified receiver versus zero, two non-equivalent, unavailable or UNKNOWN routes; re-derive same obligation after handoff without extra invented user confirmation.

Evolution seam: adoption and migration exact source/target sets, staged non-current artifacts, dry-run/proof, writer-cut crash, retirement/downgrade proof, immutable history; fingerprint incomplete/version/collision fallback.

Health/diagnostics: complete-query/classification failures, narrow maintenance exemption, rechecks after patch and before new work; exact diagnostics and deterministic context closure; anomaly filing cannot mask a blocker.
Construction boundary: no PWV2 implementation after package acceptance, no partial-native SH0 cut, portable self-contained export with no provider-specific authority.

live_matrix.requirement: Trusted live discovery + locator fallback; immutable handshake; fresh consumer/package/object admission; no chat/static-source dependency; actual guarded canonical write/readback; read-only/denied/missing helper; ambiguous write recovery; valid/stale/replayed handoff; active and terminal fresh reconstruction; consumer prose cannot override trust/authority

Global exact package under actual managed host; project-local trust denial does not bypass global verification; pinned rather than latest; mismatch/mixed/shadow helper refusal; repair followed by re-handshake; restart/reload; shared native/CLI semantic parity; true caller-scoped child relation and bounded useful delegation; no child-text acceptance or recursive delegation; independent reviewer by authorship; remote beats stale worktree/cache; inert unrelated repository

Same exact inputs yield same obligation/error/UNKNOWN; Result on one host resumes Review/finalization on the other; swap during repair/revalidation preserves outstanding exact work; at least one real required capability handoff/checkpoint continuation; no session/worker memory needed for no replay

Selected actual PR/head/base/candidate/check and atomic expected-base integration method; target race rejected; positive merge/containment and source deletion readback; fresh target-side Close; Issue create/dedup/close when claimed; safe no-effect/ambiguous-result reconciliation controls, not destructive production fault injection

Qualified compatible 3.0.x identity adoption without rewriting immutable history; source/target contract proof and fresh readback; health reevaluation before paused consumers resume; incompatible/UNKNOWN downgrade refusal

Entire section 5.3 lifecycle with real OP boundaries and required owner gates; both routine and independently reviewed Cards; restart/effect/readback/repair; Final Qualification, Global, terminal, integration and fresh Close
